templates.name: MonoMind deck
templates.tagline: Horizontal presentation deck, dark ink and accent halos.
templates.best_for: A talk. One idea per slide, read across a room.
templates.navigation: Horizontal scroll-snap, arrow keys, swipe; vertical on phones.
templates.languages: Google Translate, loaded only when a reader picks a non-English language.

templates.name: Web document
templates.tagline: Reads like a website page: top nav, sections, diagrams.
templates.best_for: Anything read at desk distance and linked to — an overview, a guide, decision records, a handbook.
templates.navigation: Top nav with hash routing (#/lang/page); each page scrolls.
templates.languages: English and Korean written inline and toggled instantly — no translation service, works offline.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts, and mermaid from a CDN for diagrams.

templates.name: Multi-page Diagrams
templates.tagline: Diagram-first deck on light paper, one drawing per slide.
templates.best_for: Architecture and system diagrams that need to be read closely, printed, and linked to.
templates.navigation: Hash routing (#lang/route) with an index page; arrows, Esc for index, L for language.
templates.languages: Every slide written twice, English and Korean, so diagram labels translate too.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts only — diagrams are inline SVG, no mermaid runtime.

templates.name: Architecture diagram
templates.tagline: System diagrams on slate, where colour means something — one view or several.
templates.best_for: A system, cloud, or network diagram that will be reviewed closely and pasted into a doc.
templates.navigation: Single page; the diagram scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.
templates.languages: English and Korean written inline — the labels inside the drawing translate too.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts only — inline SVG, no diagram runtime.

templates.name: Slide design
templates.tagline: Not a MonoMind template — twelve style presets and animated HTML slides.
templates.best_for: A deck the house style cannot shape — a different look, or animation.
templates.languages: One language per deck — the presets carry no toggle.

templates.name: Sitemap & IA proposal
templates.tagline: Argue an information architecture, with the navigation wired up to click through.
templates.best_for: Proposing or defending a site structure — a redesign's IA, a consolidation, a new build's first map. Read at desk distance by people who will approve it.
templates.navigation: Top nav with hash routing (#/lang/page); each page scrolls. The prototype page embeds a second, independent document.
templates.languages: English and Traditional Chinese written inline and toggled instantly — no translation service, works offline.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts and mermaid from a CDN for the document; Font Awesome and Tailwind from a CDN for the prototype. The delivery answer can inline all four.
features: mobile navigation prototype in its own tab
mermaid diagrams with a pan and zoom viewer

templates.name: Project website
templates.tagline: A project's public face: sticky nav, hash-routed pages, dark ink and a blue halo.
templates.best_for: A project's own site — a launch page, a tool's home, a programme's front door. Read at desk distance, linked to, and skimmed before it is read.
templates.navigation: Sticky top nav with hash routing (#/lang/page); five inline links plus a More dropdown for the rest, one footer for the whole site, burger under 960px.
templates.languages: English and Korean written inline and toggled instantly — no translation service, works offline.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts only — no diagram runtime, no CDN, no analytics.

templates.name: Evidence deck
templates.tagline: Dark full-bleed slides that argue from numbers — tables, stat rows, verdict bars.
templates.best_for: An argument someone will push back on: an audit, a diagnosis, a recommendation that has to show its evidence.
templates.navigation: Vertical scroll-snap, arrow keys, swipe; fixed progress bar and nav dots down the right edge.
templates.languages: One language per deck, written inline — no translation service, works offline.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts only — Archivo Black, Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono.

templates.name: Paper brief
templates.tagline: Light paper slides paced in chapters — mega numbers, bar charts, decision boxes.
templates.best_for: A briefing that will be read at desk distance and forwarded: a planning input, a review, a recommendation someone prints.
templates.navigation: Vertical scroll-snap, arrow keys, swipe; progress bar and nav dots, with inverted chapter pages marking the seams.
templates.languages: Traditional Chinese, single language, Noto Sans TC over Archivo — no toggle, no translation service.
templates.dependencies: Google Fonts only — Archivo and Noto Sans TC.
